jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

Find YOUR fit at Ohio Machinery Co.! Join a winning culture that strives to be the top-performing, dynamic industry leader and partner of choice for the products and solutions that help our customers build, improve, feed, power, and protect our world. Come grow your career - See what opportunities await today!

Summary

The Data Analyst will play a vital role in transforming complex data into actionable insights, supporting informed decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for evaluating dashboards and metrics, conducting training sessions to ensure effective utilization of data tools, and advocating for a data-driven culture. The Data Analyst will support and maintain data analysis systems, such as Power BI, and follow a structured business intelligence process to address specific business questions.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, technical expertise in data visualization platforms, and excellent communication abilities to effectively share insights with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Evaluate Dashboards and Metrics: Assess the accuracy, clarity, and relevance of dashboards and key performance indicators to ensure alignment with business objectives and decision-making needs.
Advocate for Dashboards: Promote the adoption and consistent use of dashboards across the organization, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making.
Collaboration: Partner with team members, managers, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify objectives, and deliver tailored data-driven solutions.
Training and Documentation: Develop, document, and deliver training plans and materials to ensure effective dashboard usage, administration, and data interpretation.
Continuous Development: Proactively expand knowledge of data warehouses, BI tools, enterprise applications, query languages, and organizational data structures to improve analytical outcomes.
System Support and Maintenance: Support and maintain data analysis platforms, including Power BI, ensuring system reliability, performance, and user accessibility.
Business Intelligence Analysis: Follow a structured BI process to address specific business questions, delivering statistical models, analytic reports, or clear data summaries.
Research and Insights Development: Conduct research on emerging data trends, best practices, and advanced analytics techniques to inform improvements in reporting and dashboard design.
Data Security and Compliance: Safeguard the integrity and security of enterprise data, adhering to best practices for privacy, security, and compliance with relevant regulations.

Minimum Skills And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Intelligence, or equivalent work experience in a related field.
4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, or a related role.
Experience supporting end-users, addressing inquiries, and resolving issues in a performance-driven environment.
Experience working with large datasets and data warehousing concepts.
Previous experience in a dealership, retail, or operational analytics environment is a plus.
Proficiency with Power BI, Excel, and other reporting tools.
Strong skills in data querying techniques and SQL.
Solid understanding of statistical analysis and data modeling.
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python or R is a plus.
Experience documenting and maintaining configuration settings and BI process documentation.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for a non-technical audience.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
Exceptional time management skills and the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Highly self-motivated and proactive, with a strong attention to detail.
Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies and reporting tools.
Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies.

Employee Benefits

401(k):Match and employer discretionary contribution.
Health Insurance:Two options are available, including an HSA with a dollar-for-dollar match of up to $1,200 per year.
Dental & Vision Insurance:Comprehensive coverage options.
Financial Access:Credit Union membership is available.
Insurance:Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability coverage.
Educational Opportunities:Scholarships for employees’ spouses and children through the Ohio Machinery Education and Opportunity Foundation.
Compensation: Base pay, annual bonus potential, and company success share bonuses.

Physical Requirements

Sitting for extended periods of time.
Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and to handle other computer components.
Lifting and transporting of moderately heavy objects, such as computers and peripherals.

EEO, Veterans & Disabled Employer and VEVRAA/503 Federal Contractor

jobs.title: Safety Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us

QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects.

Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right-of-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients.

General Description

About this Role

The Safety Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting and maintaining the organization's safety programs, ensuring compliance with corporate policies and industry standards, and promoting a culture of safety across all operations. This is an office-based position where you will be responsible for the development of safety programs across various projects and office environments. This role involves collaboration with various teams to develop, manage, and improve safety initiatives and resources.

What You'll Do

Duties

Develop and maintain safety training materials, including orientations, e-learning modules, microlearning content, and companywide interactive training sessions.
Create and translate project-specific orientations and training materials as required by clients.
Develop safety best practices, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and other instructional resources to support field safety leads and operational teams.
Manage safety-related documents and controlled materials across multiple platforms, including SharePoint, XDrive, Smartsheet, and other digital repositories.
Maintain the Safety Management Resources SharePoint site in collaboration with the Safety Program Manager and Safety Lead Administrator.
Prepare and manage safety deliverables required for bids, proposals, and contract submissions (e.g., safety narratives, safety plans, safety statistics, questionnaires).
Coordinate and provide required safety documentation and deliverables after project award, ensuring consistency with client expectations.
Assist project teams in the development, coordination, and delivery of project-specific safety plans, emergency action plans (EAPs), and other safety documentation.
Provide resources, guidance, and support to field safety leads and site managers to ensure successful implementation of safety requirements and deliverables.
Participate in weekly Active Bids and Project Update meetings, maintaining the QISG Safety Project Tracker and communicating progress to leadership.
Track and document subcontractor safety compliance using ISNetworld, Avetta, and other client-required systems.
Assist with subcontractor prequalification, ensuring alignment with client, contract, and QISG safety performance requirements.
Conduct safety program audits and evaluations to support client and internal qualification processes.
Review on-site incidents to identify causes, contributing factors, and preventive measures, working closely with operating units and subcontractors.
Compile, analyze, and present safety performance metrics, trends, and corrective actions to management.
Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen safety processes and reduce risk.
Develop, update, and coordinate Emergency Action Plans for office and project locations.
Support project teams in understanding emergency procedures, communication expectations, and client-specific requirements.
Continuously evaluate safety policies, procedures, and programs to ensure alignment with ISO 45001, client expectations, and industry standards.
Develop and implement new safety initiatives that strengthen organizational safety culture and operational readiness.
Support learning-based safety practices, including Human Performance principles and The Capacity Model™.
Collaborate with the Safety Program Manager, Safety Lead Administrator, and operations leadership to support organizational safety objectives.
Perform all additional duties as assigned by the QISG Vice President of Safety and/or QISG Safety Program Development Manager.
Provide training, coaching, and mentorship to the Safety Program Coordinator .

What You'll Bring

Required Experience and Education

Bachelor’s degree

Preferred Experience And Education

Bachelor’s degree in safety related field
Safety certification (ASP, CSP, CUSP)
2 years of safety related work experience

Skills

Self-starter
Ability to work well independently, as well as part of a team
Strong problem evaluation/solving skills
Ability to interact effectively and professionally with other team members
Strong computer skills (Microsoft Office, Excel, Adobe, Canva, Articulate Rise 360, )
Strong organizational and time management skills
Strong communication skills (verbal and written)

Travel Requirements

Percent of Time: Up to 35%

What You'll Get

Competitive Compensation
401(k) Retirement Plan
Holiday Pay
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Comprehensive Health Coverage
Pet Insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Professional Development
Tuition Assistance
Employee Discount Program

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.
